blocks.s: The oblique motion, or intellective action similar to oblique movement, befits the angels insofar as, even while they provide for lower things in their contemplation of God, they are reflected back to God (the beginning and end of all good and beauty) — for, as the Abbot of Vercelli explains, they remain without departure from themselves, uniformly and unfailingly praising within themselves the Good and the Beautiful, the cause of their unchangeableness. Dionysius says: "They are moved obliquely, because even while providing for lesser beings, they remain irreversibly around the immutable and causal Good." This operation is called oblique motion because, just as oblique motion is composed of circular and straight, so this angelic action partakes of something of the uniformity of the first (insofar as it is around God) and something of the procession to others of the second.
